title: Run of the increment carry-in phase
statement: Let $P$ be a register program with oracle, and suppose its transition at label $c_C$ is the carry-in action for incrementing register $r$, with the next state determined by the scanned bit; suppose also that $c_C$ is not an oracle-call label. For any configuration $c$ and Boolean words $w$ and $pre$, there are a time $T$ and an integer head position $p$ such that $-1\le p<|pre\mathbin{+}incW(w)|$, and the run from state $c_C$, with tape $pre\mathbin{+}w$ and head at $|pre|$, reaches state $c_B$ with tape $pre\mathbin{+}incW(w)$ and head at $p$. At every earlier time, the state is $c_C$, the tape is some word $f$, and the head position $q$ satisfies $|pre|\le q\le |pre\mathbin{+}w|$.
hypotheses_covered: Program $P$, its oracle, register $r$, labels $c_C$ and $c_B$
Transition at $c_C$ is the specified carry-in action
